title: Bit Order Control of Channel Data

c.v: The channel data will be stored as the data to be input in order from high to low.
The data bit order in each channel is controlled by
0: Not reverse the valid data bit order;
1: Reverse the valid data bit order.
At this point, the data format control is complete.
The data after format control will be sent sequentially from high to low.
Figure 28.9-1 shows a complete process of TX data format control.
